name: Fat Pack | 1.5g Infused Preroll | Watermelon Z
description: Juiced Up J: 1.5 Gram Infused Preroll - 1.2G Whole Bud Flower + 0.3G Resin - A half gram better. Watermelon x Zkittlez blend together for a juicy, candy-like strain that’s perfect for social or daytime use. Effects are uplifting, happy, and lightly relaxing, supported by terpenes Limonene, Myrcene, and Pinene. Sweet and refreshing, it’s always a crowd-pleaser.
